acceptance: scripts/check_machine_paths.py becomes scripts/check_public_hygiene.py with bounded rules. (a) Personal data: an email not in scripts/public_hygiene_allow.txt; whole-word name tokens and the username, read at run time from an untracked local list or a CI secret and never from a tracked file (skipped when both are unset), in text, as `owner:` values and in presence names of the form <username>-s<digits>; a github.com URL owned by the repo-owner handle is not a hit. (b) Machine setup: today's patterns, including `-MacBook` hostnames and /private/tmp/claude-<uid> (a bare `.local` token such as AGENTS.local.md or settings.local.json is not a hit); a `~/` path whose first component is an account-directory name from the local list (`~/.<tool>` config paths pass); home-prefixed conda or venv paths; `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=` with a value starting with / or ~; a literal number assigned to kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns; machine and apparmor profile names from the local list; variable references and placeholders are not literal values. (c) Process content: the text denylist (`deep-research report`, `claude.ai/code/session_`, `Claude-Session:`, local-list phrases) in tracked files outside sr/ and in commit messages, plus sr/work, sr/planning, sr/roadmap and sr/tools mentions in commit messages only; and, under `--promotion` only, the path denylist on tracked paths and archive member names: sr/, docs/design-notes/, scripts/census/, scripts/review_effort_study.py, a `research` directory component, a `*-prompt.md` or `handoff-*` basename, except under specy_road/templates/ and tests/parity/

scripts/public_hygiene_allow.txt holds only: noreply@anthropic.com, *@users.noreply.github.com, noreply@github.com, cursoragent@cursor.com, the dependabot address, git@github.com, *@specy-road.invalid, the reserved and synthetic test domains the suite uses (*@example.com, *@example.invalid, *@e.com, *@e.st), security@pypi.org, security@npmjs.com, and one public-author entry that ships as PUBLIC_IDENTITY_UNSET; an entry exempts only the matched span, never the line. While that entry is the placeholder the identity check is advisory (it reports and exits 0); once the operator sets it, `--promotion` fails an author or committer identity in the checked range that is neither the public identity nor an allowlisted bot, and no history before the range is checked. Rule definitions and test fixtures build denied literals by concatenation, so the scanner passes its own files with no allow entry

Pre-commit runs the file check and a pre-commit commit-msg stage runs `--commit-msg FILE`; the contributor guide gives both install commands (`pre-commit install` and `pre-commit install --hook-type commit-msg`). validate.yml checks out with fetch-depth 0 and runs default mode (tracked files, the sr/ tree skipped, no path denylist) and the message check over the event range, adding `--promotion` for a pull request or push to main; a missing range endpoint exits 1 naming it. tests/test_lean_gates.py keeps today's machine-path rows and adds the rows of the sheet test table through `main` on temporary git repos with explicit synthetic identities
nodes.title: Public-hygiene gate: personal data, machine setup and process content refused in tracked files and commit messages

No live citation outside sr/ treats a removed path as available. A citation is a link or path to docs/design-notes/, scripts/census/, scripts/review_effort_study.py or a named .cursor/rules/<name>.mdc of this repository; mentions and fixtures of a consumer .cursor/rules directory, ignore entries, CHANGELOG.md released sections, tests/parity/, and docs/release-runbook.md and docs/toolkit-development.md (M22.57 edits those) are out of scope. The shipped model-profiles README, profiles and harness-facts.yaml describe their sources in words; a diff line under specy_road/ outside templates changes only a citation; both constraints/file-limits.yaml copies drop the design-notes entries; tests/test_doc_links.py passes unchanged

tests/test_review_effort_study.py is removed with the script; in mixed tests only the read of a removed path and the asserts that depend on it go, and every other assert stays (the Cursor and Codex argv asserts in test_review_record_write.py, the docs and starter-roster asserts in test_roster_generate.py, the runbook and AGENTS.md asserts in test_release_harness.py); tests that write .cursor/rules into a temporary repository are unchanged; the commit message names each removed test or assert and the path it read. acceptance: docs/release-runbook.md and docs/toolkit-development.md describe promotion as: in an isolated release worktree, build the candidate tree exactly from the selected WIP snapshot, so a file deleted on WIP is removed too, drop every path in M22.54's path denylist, and commit it with main's recorded tip as its sole parent; the release PR lands by squash or by GitHub's two-parent merge commit, either accepted when no WIP commit becomes reachable from main, and the page names which resulting main commit is tagged; no step merges the WIP line into chore/release-* or main; both pages drop their links to this repository's .cursor/rules/; the human-owned release steps are unchanged

On a pull request or push to main, validate.yml (fetch-depth 0) runs M22.54's `--promotion` range check over base..head with the script and allowlist read from the base commit when it has them, so a candidate-local widening does not apply: every newly reachable commit, side branches included (merges diffed with -m), is refused for an addition, modification or rename destination at a denied path, while deletion-only entries pass, and the message and identity checks apply; an unresolved endpoint or failed git query exits 1 saying the history is incomplete. Tests on temporary repos: a WIP-merge range whose tip tree has no sr/, add-then-delete history and a merge of it (each refused); deletion-only cleanup, the clean promotion commit and a two-parent landing merge with no WIP history (each accepted); a candidate allowlist widening (still refused); a missing base (exit 1)

release-publish.yml, in the existing build job before either publish job, unpacks the sdist and wheel into plain directories and runs M22.54's `--promotion` file and path checks over them without a git index (member paths relative to the distribution root, the sdist prefix removed), and scripts/verify_wheel_contents.py checks both archives for denied member paths; a scan or read failure exits non-zero and stops the publish; the trusted-publisher step is unchanged. tests/test_verify_wheel_contents.py adds a zip and a tar fixture: a denied member such as docs/design-notes/x.md fails naming it, denied text in an allowed member fails, the shipped template paths pass, and the existing required-file rows stay
nodes.title: Promotion is one squashed commit on main without WIP history, and the built sdist and wheel pass the hygiene gate before publish

acceptance: On a fresh `git clone --mirror` with the pull-request refs fetched, never a working checkout, the rehearsal first records every source head, tag and pull-request ref with its SHA, and stops before filter-repo while M22.54's public-author entry is the placeholder or absent. git filter-repo then runs with --invert-paths for each prefix in the sheet list that has history, never for a path the WIP tip still tracks (work/.gitkeep and work/README.md stay; omitted prefixes are named in the evidence); --replace-text for home paths and local-list names; --mailmap mapping only the identities on M22.54's untracked local list to the operator-set public identity; and a --message-callback that deletes Claude-Session: lines, rewrites sr/work, sr/planning, sr/roadmap and sr/tools mentions to <private> and removes local-list names

Using an explicit inventory of all mirror refs, M22.54's applicable rules, with no WIP sr/ exemption, scan every reachable commit's paths and text blobs (each blob once), messages and author and committer identities, not only the tips; a hit at a shipped product path still on the pre-rewrite tip and not inverted is recorded, not failed; any other hit, or a scan or read failure, stops the rehearsal, and a local fixture with a forbidden value added then deleted before the tip fails the scan. The evidence goes to an untracked folder outside every tracked tree and is never committed: the recorded source SHAs, the old-to-new SHA map, the saved refs/pull/* list, the scan output and the operator script; the sheet records the folder as a placeholder path and the sha256 of the script and the scan output

The operator script never pushes. It exits non-zero and prints nothing pushable while the public identity is unset or differs from the mailmap target, or when any source ref differs from the recorded inventory (a moved, added or removed head or tag). Otherwise it stops after checking the rewritten mirror and the map, and prints the push commands separately: branch updates for refs/heads/* with expected-old-tip leases; then tag updates under a warning that pushing v* tags runs .github/workflows/release-publish.yml, so the operator disables or guards that workflow first; then the new-repository commands. refs/pull/* are listed for the Support request and never pushed. The agent runs the script only in its refusal and print-only paths and runs no push, visibility change, Support request or TestPyPI step
nodes.title: History-rewrite rehearsal on a mirror: filter-repo run, hygiene gate over every ref, an operator script and the old-to-new SHA map

acceptance: human: before the push, the sheet lists the machines (the operator's list) and each one's `git worktree list`, and every worker and grind session on them is stopped; the operator has pushed the rewritten branches with M22.58's printed commands, or moved to a new repository, and has updated no v* tag until each TestPyPI candidate rc1 to rc4 is yanked or deleted or release-publish.yml is disabled; the sheet records the route, the date the GitHub Support request for pull-request refs and cached views was filed, one yank-or-delete line per candidate with its date, and that each listed machine and worktree was re-cloned; a fresh `git clone --mirror` has exactly the heads and tags of M22.58's approved inventory, passes the same history-wide scan, and reaches no old commit that the rewrite changed
